method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Indian shares may open higher as traders trim Fed hike bets
Equities.reason: Represents regional equity reaction to a broader easing of Fed rate-hike expectations — supports a risk-on, liquidity-improving equity narrative.

Equities.title: Stocks Climb as Fed-Hike Wagers Ease on Waller: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Direct market-wide piece tying equity gains to lower Fed-hike odds — strong positive for broad risk sentiment and equities.

Equities.title: US Stocks and Treasuries Steady Before Jobs Data: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Market caution ahead of US jobs data — limits near-term directional conviction but is relevant to macro-driven equity flows.

Equities.title: Nvidia strikes $12.9bn deal to buy AI platform Hugging Face
Equities.reason: Major consolidation in AI leadership — reinforces dominant market narrative that Nvidia (and AI capex) is primary equity-market driver.

Equities.title: Hugging Face approached Nvidia’s Huang weeks ahead of $12.9B acquisition, CEO tells CNBC
Equities.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said that with Hugging Face, the chipmaker will "expand access to AI for developers and institutions worldwide."
Equities.reason: Corroborating detail on the Nvidia deal that amplifies AI leadership narrative; supportive but incremental to the primary story.

Equities.title: Anthropic Nears Finalizing $15 Billion Pre-IPO Credit Facility
Equities.reason: Large private-market financing for an AI leader signals sustained investor appetite and liquidity for AI-related equities.

Equities.title: OpenAI begins rolling out Astra model after warning of its advanced cyber capabilities
Equities.summary: OpenAI said companies participating in its application-based cybersecurity program will be first to get access to Astra.
Equities.reason: Product rollout by a major AI player underscores ongoing AI monetization and supports sector leadership that is driving equity flows.

Rates.title: The inflation genie could be out of the bottle — and bond markets are sounding the alarm
Rates.summary: Global bond yields have surged as investors assess whether rising debt, tariffs, defense spending and energy shocks could keep inflation higher for longer.
Rates.reason: Direct signal that bond yields are rising on higher‑for‑longer inflation risk and fiscal/energy shocks — negative for bond prices and a clear rates selloff narrative.

Rates.title: The world appears to be entering a higher-rate era. Here’s who will pay the price
Rates.summary: The bond sell-off is owed to a mix of high government debt issuance, an oil-price shock that has reignited inflation concerns, and expectations of higher rates.
Rates.reason: Reinforces the dominant market regime shift to higher yields driven by issuance and inflation/energy shocks — meaningful negative for bond markets.

Rates.title: Manager of Norway’s $2tn oil fund proposes slashing US Treasury holdings
Rates.summary: Overhaul of bond positions suggested to Ministry of Finance aims to boost returns
Rates.reason: Large institutional plans to cut UST exposure increase supply/flow pressure on Treasuries — a material negative for bond prices and yields higher.

Rates.title: Global bond sell-off likely not over yet, Mohamed El-Erian tells CNBC
Rates.summary: In a wide-ranging interview, the renowned economist also said the U.S. Treasury had taken "a step too far" with its market intervention.
Rates.reason: Expert view that the sell‑off may continue and that policy/issuance interventions have been insufficient — reinforces negative bond-price momentum.

Rates.title: Wall Street is betting on Fed Chair Warsh to keep a manic bond market from unraveling
Rates.reason: Market expectation that Fed leadership will act to stabilise bond markets is a modestly positive offset for bonds (could cap further yield rises).

Rates.title: Japan’s Katayama says will closely monitoring bond markets with heightened urgency
Rates.summary: Japanese Finance Minister (FM) Satsuki Katayama said on Friday that the officials will closely monitoring bond markets with heightened urgency.
Rates.reason: Official warning from Japan signals stress in JGBs and potential for policy/market intervention — near‑term negative for global bond sentiment and volatility.

Rates.title: Mortgage Rates Climb to Highest Level Since July 2025
Rates.reason: Higher consumer mortgage rates reflect elevated underlying Treasury yields — a transmission to credit-sensitive rates and an additional negative signal for bond markets.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index weakens as Fed’s Waller signals rate pause
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is losing ground for the third consecutive day and trading around 99.00 during Asian hours on Friday.
FX.reason: Fed official signalling a pause is a clear USD-negative macro driver; DXY down for third day implies broader USD weakness and potential cross-currency gains (EUR/GBP/AUD/NZD/JPY). High relevance as a market-regime signal ahead of NFP.

FX.title: Carry Trade Exodus Fuels Yen Surge Ahead of BOJ Rate Decision
FX.reason: Large-scale carry unwinds and rate-bet dynamics are a dominant FX flow pushing JPY strength vs USD and other FX; material market-moving theme ahead of BOJ decision.

FX.title: Yen’s $103 Billion Short Risks Unwind Below 155, JPMorgan Says
FX.reason: JPMorgan highlights large short positions that could squeeze and amplify JPY strength — reinforces yen-surge narrative and potential for volatile USD/JPY moves.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Policy signals support JPY against US Dollar - Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Thu Lan Nguyen argues that recent interventions by Japanese authorities and the US Treasury have largely lost impact, with the Japanese Yen giving back gains against the Dollar and US yields returning to prior levels.
FX.reason: A counter-signal noting fading intervention impact and JPY giving back gains; lowers confidence in a persistent yen rally — treated as a lower-relevance dissenting view.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar advances as US Dollar struggles on softening hawkish expectations
FX.summary: NZD/USD gains ground for the second successive day, trading around 0.5900 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) struggles amid softening hawkish expectations surrounding the Federal Reserve's (Fed) monetary policy path.
FX.reason: NZD strength consistent with USD weakness from easing Fed hike bets; supports broad risk-permissive, USD-weak narrative and cross-rate appreciation.

FX.title: Australian Dollar edges higher above 0.7200 on rising RBA hike bets, eyes on US NFP data
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair gathers strength to near 0.7210 during the early European session on Friday. The US Dollar (USD) weakens against the Australian Dollar (AUD) following Federal Reserve (Fed) Governor Christopher Waller’s remarks.
FX.reason: AUD appreciation reflects both local rate-bet support and USD softness; reinforces the USD-weak, commodity/carry-linked currency strength theme.

FX.title: British Pound strengthens above 1.3500 as BoE stays hawkish, traders brace for US NFP data
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair edges higher to around 1.3530 during the early European trading hours on Friday. Hawkish rhetoric from a Bank of England (BoE) policymaker provides some support to the British Pound (GBP) against the US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: GBP strength driven by BoE rhetoric adds to USD-soft backdrop; relevant to USD-centric flows though partly idiosyncratic to UK policy.

FX.title: Indian Rupee: RBI inflows and reduced tail risks – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Michael Wan notes strong Indian Rupee (INR) outperformance driven by larger-than-expected US Dollar (USD) inflows from Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) FCNR(B) measures, which now exceed US$130bn.
FX.reason: INR outperformance is tied to large USD inflows and reduced tail risks; supports view of cross-border FX flows affecting USD and EMFX dynamics — medium relevance.

FX.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: US Dollar recovery is likely to be tested at 156.70 area
FX.summary: The Japanese Yen (JPY) is trimming some gains against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, but still on track to its strongest weekly performance since July’s US-Japan coordinated intervention.
FX.reason: Technical/forecast piece suggesting a possible USD recovery vs JPY — treated as a low-relevance tactical counterpoint to the broader yen-strength theme.

Commodities.title: Gold: Rebound on softer Fed expectations – OCBC
Commodities.summary: OCBC’s Christopher Wong reports Gold rebounded over 2% towards 4510 as Waller’s comments led markets to pare September Fed hike expectations, lowering UST yields and the Dollar.
Commodities.reason: Softer Fed expectations lower real yields and the USD which is a clear bullish driver for gold; multiple similar headlines reinforce the market-wide narrative, giving this above-average relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold remains on the defensive as USD steadies ahead of key US NFP report
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) edges lower on Friday, snapping a two-day winning streak amid a modest US Dollar (USD) uptick.
Commodities.reason: USD intraday strength and near-term NFP risk weighing on gold; important as a short-term counter-signal but lower relevance than Fed-expectation-driven rebound stories.

Commodities.title: Gold to End Volatile Week Higher as Fedspeak Trims Rate-Hike Bet
Commodities.reason: Bloomberg headline aligns with the dominant macro driver for gold — Fedspeak trimming rate-hike bets — supportive but treated as reinforcing piece rather than novel.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD corrects $66.30 amid caution ahead of US NFP data
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) retreats to near $66.30 in the European trading session on Friday after posting a fresh five-day high near $68.00. The white metal comes under pressure ahead of the United States (US) Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data for August, which will be
Commodities.reason: Technical/near-term NFP-driven caution for silver; price-forecast piece so capped relevance per framework and shows short-term consolidation risk.

Commodities.title: WTI Price Forecast: Bulls await acceptance above $90.00 and 61.8% Fibo. amid Iran risks
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – trades below the $90.00 mark during the Asian session on Friday and remains close to its highest level since July 24, touched earlier this week.
Commodities.reason: Iran/geo-political risk and oil trading near multi-week highs is a clear bullish commodity theme; technical commentary reinforced by geopolitical drivers gives this high relevance and bullish direction.

Commodities.title: Oil: Elevated prices face fragile support – ING
Commodities.summary: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that Oil prices, including ICE Brent above US$95/bbl, remain supported by heightened US-Iran tensions and robust Iraqi exports routed via the Strait of Hormuz.
Commodities.reason: Analyst note highlighting supportive geopolitical tensions (US-Iran) and supply routing via Strait of Hormuz; bullish bias but flagged as 'fragile', so relevance is material but cautious.

Commodities.title: Oil Heads for Biggest Weekly Gain Since July on Iran War Risks
Commodities.reason: Bloomberg flags a sizable weekly move driven by Iran war risks — a market-moving geopolitical supply-risk narrative that materially elevates oil-market relevance and bullishness.

Commodities.title: Trump-linked companies race to secure deals for Venezuela’s oil
Commodities.summary: Appointees, a donor and a recent administration official are among those capitalising on US control of beleaguered energy sector
Commodities.reason: Deals to unlock Venezuelan oil production point to potential medium-term supply additions; this is a modest bearish structural signal for oil, but lower relevance vs acute geopolitical risk headlines.

Commodities.title: U.S. LNG exports rose 23% in the first half of 2026 because of higher capacity
Commodities.summary: U.S. liquefied natural gas (LNG) exports averaged 17.4 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in the first six months of the year, 23% more than the same period in 2025, according to our Natural Gas Monthly. In our latest Short-Term Energy Outlook, we estimate U.S
Commodities.reason: Higher US LNG export capacity supports global gas demand fundamentals and can be bullish for natural gas prices and energy-market flows; relevant but not an acute shock.

Commodities.title: Eight petroleum liquids pipeline projects have been completed since the start of 2025
Commodities.summary: In the 2026 release of our Liquids Pipeline Projects Database, we tracked the completion of 8 liquid fuels pipeline projects since the start of 2025, and an additional 14 new projects have been announced.
Commodities.reason: New pipeline capacity eases transportation bottlenecks for petroleum liquids, a structural supply-flow improvement that is mildly bearish for oil prices over time.

Commodities.title: Argentina's Milei escalates Falklands dispute as Trump questions U.S. support for Britain
Commodities.summary: Argentina's President Javier Milei has renewed the country's claim to the Falkland Islands and threatened sanctions on oil companies.
Commodities.reason: Escalation of the Falklands dispute and threats to sanction oil firms raising regional geopolitical risk that can support oil price risk premia; moderately relevant to oil markets.

Crypto.title: Live updates: Bitcoin jumps above $81,000 as rates fall, dollar weakens
Crypto.reason: Macro-driven crypto rally: falling rates and a weaker dollar are lifting BTC and majors. Strong USD/interest-rate transmission into crypto markets makes this high-relevance positive for BTC/crypto risk assets.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin back above $81,000 as hike odds fade, Zcash leads with 15% jump
Crypto.reason: Price/market-micro story reinforcing the same macro narrative: fading Fed hike odds are supportive for BTC and altcoins. Useful as a market-confirmation signal with material, but somewhat overlapping, relevance.

Crypto.title: U.S. banking agency gives blockchain bank OpenReserve initial OK to operate
Crypto.reason: Regulatory/financial-integration positive: a banking agency granting initial approval to a blockchain bank is a clear institutional legitimization and potential catalyst for crypto banking/custody flows.

Crypto.title: Bitget in talks with Wall Street giants including BlackRock to fuel Asian distribution
Crypto.reason: Institutional distribution/adoption positive: talks with large asset managers for Asian distribution point to more institutional flows and product expansion in crypto.

Crypto.title: SoFi, Kraken tie up as crypto and banking push into each other's turf
Crypto.reason: Banking-crypto integration: partnership between a bank/fintech and an exchange supports mainstreaming of crypto services and could increase on-ramps and liquidity.

Crypto.title: A memecoin making app becomes crypto’s top fee generators as Robinhood Chain activity explodes
Crypto.reason: On-chain activity/revenue signal: surging memecoin activity increases fee generation and chain usage — positive for network economics but idiosyncratic and higher risk/noise.

Crypto.title: Australia is cracking down on crypto businesses as its strict new regulatory deadline nears
Crypto.reason: Regulatory tightening negative: stricter enforcement deadlines increase operational and compliance risk for crypto firms in a major market, weighing on sentiment and regional flows.

Crypto.title: Crypto made new friends in U.S. primaries, but focus now shifts to general election
Crypto.reason: Political/regulatory backdrop: improved political support for crypto in primaries is modestly positive for long-term regulatory prospects, though election focus may shift debates.

Crypto.title: Crypto for Advisors: Why crypto earnings reports can be misleading
Crypto.reason: Market-structure/communications note with low signal: misleading earnings disclosures may increase short-term volatility and investor confusion, but overall impact is limited.
